spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (छेदयति)
To cut, to cover, to divide, but especially into two parts.

m. (-दः)
1 Cutting, dividing.
2 A part, a portion.
3 Solving, dissipating, (as doubt.)
4 The denominator of a fraction.
5 The divisor.
E.
छिद to cut, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Cutting.
m. (-रः)
A wood-cutter.
E.
छेद, and कर who makes.

n. (-नं)
1 Cutting, dividing.
2 A part, a portion.
E.
छिद to cut, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be cut or divided.
E.
छिद to cut, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि)
Cutting, dividing, a cutter, &c.
E.
छिद to cut, Uṇādi affix इन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cut, divided.
E.
छिद to cut, affix क्त.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be cut or divided.
E.
छिद to cut, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
To be cut or divided.
n. (-द्यं)
Amputation, excision^1.
E.
छिद to cut, यत् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.
